customers_say: Customers find the water purifier delivers clean, safe drinking water consistently and appreciate its elegant design. The installation process is smooth, and they like the taste, with one customer noting the ability to control it according to water source. While some customers say it works well and consider it worth the price, others report it completely stops working and consider it a waste of money. The service receives mixed feedback, with some praising it while others find it terrible.

reviews.author: Kavi Chakravarthi
reviews.title: Wonderful product
reviews.body: Working great, worth for every penny
